summary: Create nested exported namespace object as outer property.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: nested
tests.input: namespace A { export namespace B { export const x=1 } }; console.log(A.B.x);

tests.name: object
tests.input: namespace A { export namespace B {} }; console.log(typeof A.B);
